findings.evidence: `TauCeti/RingTheory/Valuation/CofinalIdeal/Greatest.lean:579` defines `characteristicSubgroupOfIdeal_eq_top_iff_forall_span` with independent ideals `I` and `J`, assumptions `Ideal.span T = J` and `I.radical = J.radical`; line 71 currently discards that generality by passing `rfl`.
findings.fix: Add `{J : Ideal A}`, replace `hspan : Ideal.span T = I` with `hspan : Ideal.span T = J`, add `hrad : I.radical = J.radical`, and pass `hrad` to the criterion; specialize with `J := I` and `rfl` below.
findings.issue: `mem_spvOfIdeal_of_isContinuous_of_span` is under-generalized by requiring `Ideal.span T = I`; membership only depends on cofinal generators of any ideal `J` with `I.radical = J.radical`.

summary: The general helper unnecessarily requires the nilpotent spanning set to generate `I` itself, although the underlying API only requires it to generate an ideal with the same radical.
